responsibilities.copyDelay: interaction-delay: public copy-delay default3000ms; not CSS visual completion
responsibilities.measurement: RAF batching and synchronous CSS geometry, not a duration token
responsibilities.cancellation: Replace copy feedback; cancel on copyable/disabled/copy-delay change, suspension/disposal. Measurement cancel on replacement/config/expansion/edit/suspension/disposal.
responsibilities.guards: Timer/frame generation and one-time consumption; active/disposed checks; node and post-measure reentrancy; observer lifecycle epoch rebind on activation.
responsibilities.unchanged: Public APIs, CSS variables/colors/default delay and existing global raf/caf ownership.

verification.runnerNote: One 25-test passing run had a Vitest0.22.1 fsevents native assertion at teardown/close timeout. Independent final run passed25 and exited0 without the teardown error; the configured typecheck/lint chain also exited0. Do not confuse assertions with process success.
verification.repairNote: Intermediate local ellipsis destructuring shadowed prop ref and caused TDZ; renamed measuredEllipsis and reran. Old binding invalidation also forces fresh handler render after activation.

coverage.scope: Runtime source-candidate classification, NOT all-library acceptance or count of defects. Previously audited components can remain unclassified.
coverage.grouping: Top-level public component directory; merge same names across platforms; exclude underscore-prefixed infrastructure and utils/.
coverage.refreshScope: Only reviewed Typography runtime line/hash; other date/parallel CSS drift preserved.

boundaries: Controlled Vue KeepAlive/JSDOM with clipboard, measure, raf/caf, Operations/ResizeObserver/Tooltip stubs; no native clipboard or layout proof.
